swap_en: Less rice + extra cucumber, lim kopi-o kosong — save ~180 kcal
swap_zh: 少饭多黄瓜，咖啡乌 kosong — 省约180千卡
tip_en: Wah, shiok but rich! Ask for less oil on rice.
tip_zh: 哇，很好吃但很油！叫少油饭。

swap_en: Try laksa yong-tau-foo soup version — save ~300 kcal
swap_zh: 试试叻沙酿豆腐汤版 — 省约300千卡
tip_en: Wah, 920 kcal! Share the gravy, don't drink finish.

swap_en: Ask for less oil + extra bean sprouts — save ~200 kcal
swap_zh: 叫少油多豆芽 — 省约200千卡
tip_en: Wok hei power! Half plate + fruit is steady.
tip_zh: 锅气十足！吃半盘加水果更稳。

swap_en: 1 kosong + dhal instead of curry — save ~220 kcal
swap_zh: 一片 kosong 配扁豆咖喱 — 省约220千卡
tip_en: Crispy kosong hits different. Dhal > curry.
tip_zh: 脆脆 kosong 最好吃。扁豆咖喱更健康。

swap_en: Soup base + brown rice, skip fried items — save ~120 kcal
swap_zh: 选汤底加糙米，不拿油炸 — 省约120千卡
tip_en: Best hawker hack already. Soup don't finish can liao.
tip_zh: 已经是最聪明的选择。汤别喝完就行。

swap_en: Soup version + extra chye sim — save ~150 kcal
swap_zh: 选汤面加多菜心 — 省约150千卡
tip_en: Dry or soup both can. Chilli small-small can liao.
tip_zh: 干捞汤面都行。辣椒少少就好。

swap_en: Less santan rice + ikan kuning, skip luncheon meat — save ~250 kcal
swap_zh: 少椰浆饭选甘望鱼，不加午餐肉 — 省约250千卡
tip_en: Sambal is life but sodium bomb. Dab, don't drown.
tip_zh: 参巴是灵魂但很咸。点到为止。

swap_en: Chicken-only sticks + ketupat half — save ~140 kcal
swap_zh: 全选鸡肉串加半个马来粽 — 省约140千卡
tip_en: Protein king! Peanut sauce two spoon max.
tip_zh: 蛋白质之王！花生酱最多两勺。

swap_en: Mee kia soup + lean pork, less lard — save ~130 kcal
swap_zh: 选幼面汤加瘦肉少猪油 — 省约130千卡
tip_en: Vinegar kick shiok. Ask 'less lard' uncle understands.
tip_zh: 黑醋够味。讲少猪油 uncle 明白的。

swap_en: Half portion + telur rebus (not goreng) — save ~170 kcal
swap_zh: 吃半盘加水煮蛋 — 省约170千卡
tip_en: Sweet-spicy shiok. Lime squeeze cuts the jelak.
tip_zh: 酸甜辣过瘾。挤酸柑解腻。

swap_en: Brown rice + extra lettuce — save ~90 kcal
swap_zh: 换糙米多生菜 — 省约90千卡
tip_en: Lightest legend. Add milk only if you must.
tip_zh: 最清爽的选择。加奶少少就好。

swap_en: Less gravy + extra vinegar + half noodles — save ~160 kcal
swap_zh: 少卤汁多醋少面 — 省约160千卡
tip_en: Gravy lover? Ask gravy separate, you control.
tip_zh: 爱卤汁？叫卤汁分开，自己控制。
